notes: Graded case: the agent writes the Management API request bodies for a consumer portal and its portal application, without calling any API. Graders read the files it writes. Setup and audit command flows are in universal-portals-cli.json (expectations-only, they need a tenant).

evals.prompt:
Set up a consumer self-service portal on my Auth0 tenant dev-example.us.auth0.com using the Management API directly, not the CLI setup command.

Write two files and do not call any API:
- `portal.json`: the body for POST /api/v2/portals. Slug `my-account`, name `My Account`. A Profile page with one Auth0 Form (form ID `form_abc123`) and a Security page with MFA and passkey management. Link both pages from the sidebar and make Profile the default page.
- `portal-app.json`: the body for POST /api/v2/clients for the Regular Web Application that backs the portal. Users return to https://app.example.com after logout.

Use placeholders for secrets.
evals.expected_output: portal.json uses pages.standard, :v2 sidebar links with page_slug, a pages.default, sections with form, mfa_management and passkey_management components. portal-app.json is a regular_web app with authorization_code, refresh_token and MFA grants only, non-rotating refresh tokens, the portals callback URL, the application URL as logout URL, and organization_usage allow.
expectations: portal.json puts pages under pages.standard with pages.default set
Sidebar links use the :v2 types with page_slug
Security page uses mfa_management and passkey_management components
portal-app.json callback is https://<domain>/portals/auth/callback and logout is the application URL
No Management API grant is requested for the portal application

graders.description: Default page is set to the Profile page slug
Sidebar uses the v2 internal link type
Sidebar links target pages with page_slug
The unversioned internal link type is not used
The existing Form ID is used, not a fabricated one
Portal application has no Client Credentials grant or Management API scopes
Callback URL is the shared portals callback
First allowed logout URL is the application URL, not the portal URL
